title: Purab Aur Paschim
desc: An Indian student in London confronts western values and cultural loss. His journey bridges tradition and modernity, reminding us of identity, patriotism, and the strength of roots.

title: Dhadkan
desc: Anjali loves Dev, but family pressure forces her to marry Ram. Years later, Dev returns to win her back, only to find she has grown to love her husband.

title: Ghajini
desc: After a brutal head injury, Sanjay loses the ability to retain memories beyond fifteen minutes. With clues tattooed on his body, he embarks on a relentless quest to find his fiancee's killer.

title: Vivah - Journey From Engagement to Marriage
desc: Poonam, an orphan engaged to wealthy Prem, suffers first-degree burns in a house fire just days before their wedding, testing love, resilience, and family bonds.

title: Sooryavanshi
desc: With Mumbai under threat of a major terrorist attack, ATS chief Sooryavanshi launches a high-stakes mission to track down 600 kg of missing RDX and the masterminds behind the plot.

title: Singham Again
desc: Drawing parallels to the Ramayana, Bajirao Singham leads his team on a daring mission to rescue his wife while facing a powerful and mysterious enemy.

title: Great Grand Masti
desc: Three friends meet Ragini in a small town. Her beauty charms them, but soon they realise she brings danger, mystery, and trouble into their lives.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

title: God Tussi Great Ho
desc: Arun blames God for his troubles, but when God appears and grants him divine powers, Arun tries to make the world better by fulfilling everyone's wishes.

title: Bombay To Goa
desc: Mala, a young woman who witnesses a murder, flees on a Goa-bound bus. Along the way, she meets colourful travellers from different cultures and a spirited young man who refuses to leave her side.

title: Singh Is King
desc: Happy, known for his wild antics, is sent to bring Lakhan to his ailing father. In Australia, events take a turn as Happy accidentally assumes Lakhan's role as the local underworld king.

title: Baadshah
desc: A small time private detective gets embroiled in an industrialist's plot to assassinate a political leader.

title: Andaz Apna Apna
desc: Two ambitious rivals chase wealth by pursuing an heiress, but their plans spiral into confusion when a family plot and hidden identity create unexpected trouble.

title: Odela 2
desc: In a remote village with rich traditions, the savior Odela Mallanna Swamy always protects his people from evil forces.

title: Prem Ratan Dhan Payo
desc: A commoner named Prem swaps places with Prince Vijay Singh before a tense coronation. As plots unfold, Princess Maithili, meant to wed Vijay, finds herself drawn to Prem.

title: Commando 3
desc: Officers Karan and Bhavana travel to London on a high-stakes mission after uncovering a threat to India, racing against time to foil a planned terrorist attack.
